sentences.text:
This Criminal Appeal under Section 374(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 08.03.2017 in S.T.No.74/2013 by the Special Judge, ST/SC (POA)
Act, Mandleshwar, District Khargone whereby appellant/accused has been convicted for offence under Sections 363, 366, 366(A), 376(2)(i), 376(2)(n), 372, 506(2) of the IPC and Section 5(i) / 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 2 years R.I., 3 years R.I., 3 years R.I., 10 years R.I., 10 years R.I., 3 years R.I., 1 years R.I. & 10 years R.I. and fine of Rs.2,000/-, Rs.2,000/-, Rs.3,000/- ,
Rs.3,000/-, Rs.3,000/- , Rs.3,000/- and Rs.3,000 (in section 5(i)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012) Act, 2012 respectively with default stipulation.
2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 08/07/2013 whereby appellant abducted an adolescent 15 years old girl, detained her in his house, raped her twice.

He took her to several places,
detained her, raped her, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21604 2 CRA-721-2017 ultimately sold her in Banglore for Rs.2.50 lakhs to the co-accused persons under the threat of life and regarding which a Crime No.176/2013 was registered at Police Station Chainpur, District Khargone.

3. The PUD No.827/Warrant/2025 dated 20.05.2025 of Jail Superintendent, District Jail, Khargone (M.P.) mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 07.01.2022 after completing the sentence and depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
